cc:Work.dc:source: boxes CompartmentBox --format svg --sx 125 --sy 28:50 --h 31 --outside false --bottom_edge F --handle lip --radius 10 --holes 70 --margin_t 0.1 --margin_s 0.05 --split_lip false --thickness 2.9 --burn 0.1 --labels true --reference 100 --tabs 0 --qr_code false --inner_corners loop --spacing 0.5 --Stackable_angle 60 --Stackable_bottom_stabilizers 0 --Stackable_height 2 --Stackable_holedistance 1 --Stackable_width 4
cc:Work.dc:description:
Type tray variation with sliding lid
Sliding lid rests on inner walls, so will not work if no inner walls are present. Suggested to place walls close to both sides for maximum stability. Margin helps to prevent the lid from getting stuck. Vertical margin increases the overall height. The lip holding the lid in place can be generated as two separate pieces or as a single piece that continues at the back.
![Closed](static/samples/CompartmentBox-closed.jpg) ![Half open](static/samples/CompartmentBox-lid.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes CompartmentBox --format svg --sx 125 --sy 28:50 --h 31 --outside false --bottom_edge F --handle lip --radius 10 --holes 70 --margin_t 0.1 --margin_s 0.05 --split_lip false --thickness 2.9 --burn 0.1 --labels true --reference 100 --tabs 0 --qr_code false --inner_corners loop --spacing 0.5 --Stackable_angle 60 --Stackable_bottom_stabilizers 0 --Stackable_height 2 --Stackable_holedistance 1 --Stackable_width 4 Command line short: boxes CompartmentBox --sx --sy --h --outside --bottom_edge --split_lip --thickness --spacing
